# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.20 — Architecture remediation

<!-- update-summary: Preview.20 is the verified follow-up to the Preview.19 whole-repository architecture audit. The final summary is maintained from shipped implementation and test evidence. -->

Preview.20 is the architecture-remediation development line following the published Preview.19 baseline. This file is intentionally conservative during implementation: it must be updated before publication to describe only changes that are present in the final commit and supported by release evidence.

The release preserves the Windows 10 version 1809 / Build 17763 and later x64 boundary, Dynamic Island product boundary, local-first storage, external-source reference-only rule, existing Smart Drag/OLE and Clipboard contracts, and Stable/Preview update semantics.

## Verification boundary

Hosted Windows CI/release, automated fault-injection, website/API checks, and package validation will be recorded here as they pass. Real Windows build/DPI/multi-monitor/provider/OLE/accessibility behavior, two-device LAN behavior, operator-deployed Worker/browser behavior, physical disk-full/SMB failures, and long-run performance evidence remain explicitly conditional unless directly executed on their target environments.

No Preview.20 claim is considered complete until its implementation, regression tests, release artifacts, and public verification are complete.
